body:

[SirFaffer] Answers, because I know the questions are coming.
x2d is worth the extra over the p2s no question.
if you want to print asa/abs/nylon and what have you get the x2d
if you want to print toys and models in multiple colours without excess waste with PLA and PETG get the snapmaker u1
if you want to print toys as per above and want to print ASA as well get the U1 and put a lid on it
if you want all of the above get both or get the H2C
if you want to just print single colours and/or want to dip your toes in at minimal cost buy a prusa i3 mk3s off facebook for $150
*Note - the U1 doesn't come with hardened nozzles. So if you want to print glow in the dark or metal/cf infused abrasive filaments then factor in a set of hardened nozzles as well.
[goodwillN1] What if I want to print multitude of materials in one colour but want the second one for cheap material supports?
[SirFaffer] Using petg support interface on pla prints (or vice versa) is where the X2D shines.
